sick_message: Your team lead will be notified and a running clock will be stopped. You can upload a doctor's note afterwards under Absences.
sick_done: Get well soon! Your team lead has been informed.

setup.title: Getting started
setup.sub: {done} of {total} steps done. Work through this list once and your company is ready to track time.
setup.rules_help: Full-time week, how public holidays count, break warnings and whether edits need a reason. Save the page once to confirm.
setup.email_help: Needed for invitations, password resets and notifications. Configured in the .env file; send a test email to verify.
setup.holidays_help: The company default calendar needs the holidays of your canton or region. Import them for the coming years.
setup.teams_help: Group employees and name leads (and deputies) who approve vacation and sign off months.
setup.employees_help: Add each person with their start date, employment level and weekly schedule. They receive an invitation email.
setup.branding_help: Upload your company logo and pick an accent colour under Settings → Branding.
setup.backups_help: A backup is written every night. Download one and store it outside this server.
setup.docs_hint: The administrator guide in the documentation explains each step in detail.
setup.roles_help: Administrators see no time data. Grant the HR capability (Employees → Edit) to whoever signs off months and runs reports, and name leads on the Teams page.

overnight: You have been clocked in since {since}. If you forgot to clock out, clock out now and correct the entry.
weekly_max_exceeded: Above the legal weekly maximum of {max}
